paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model over the course of training, as a function of the training step. The x-axis, labeled "Training Step," is scaled linearly and ranges from 0 to 1400, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled "Training Loss," is also linear and spans from 0.3 to 0.7, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A single blue line with no markers represents the training loss, which starts at approximately 0.75 at step 0 and decreases sharply in the initial phase, reaching around 0.4 by step 200. After this point, the loss continues to decline gradually, stabilizing between 0.3 and 0.35 from approximately step 800 to step 1400, with small oscillations indicating fluctuations during training. The legend indicates that the blue line corresponds to the "Training Loss of Reward Model."
